title: Unobtainables+
description: Tired of searching dungeons just to find a saddle or a totem of undying?
body:
Tired of searching dungeons just to find a saddle or a totem of undying?
This lightweight mod brings back crafting recipes for some of the most requested uncraftable items in vanilla Minecraft — and also adds a few new decorative paintings to personalize your world.

## ✅ Features:

# 🛠️ Crafting Recipes Added:

- Totem of Undying – crafted with emeralds and gold
- 
- Saddle – crafted with leather, lead and strings
- 
- Leash (Lead) – crafted with strings and iron nugget
- 
- Chainmail Armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) – crafted iron nuggets, chains

# 🖼️ New Paintings:

- Cat – a soft and cozy addition to your walls
- 
- Creepy – cat with a creeper
- 
- Sunset – a peaceful landscape to calm your nerves

# 🎮 Compatibility:

- Fully client and server compatible
- 
- Works with other recipe and painting mods
- 
- Requires Forge 1.20.1

Perfect for builders, survival players, and anyone who wants more control over crafting in their Minecraft world.
